item.title: Adsure Services profits jump amid new growth strategy launch
item.summary: Adsure Services has reported a year of sharply improved profitability and set out an ambitious plan to reshape itself into a cluster of specialist professional services firms. For the year ended 31 March 2026, the holding company for business assurance provider TIAA Limited grew operating profit by 18.4% to £1.07m, up from £0.9m.
